learning_outcomes: Imitate the facial expressions for happy, sad, smile, and cry.
Say the word "happy" while making a happy face.
Repeat the sentence patterns using happy, sad, smile, and cry.

activities.title: Community Circle Time 5 min
activities.content:
• Welcome children with a smiling face.
• Say: Good morning, everyone!
• Children: "Good morning, Teacher!"
• Say: Look at my face! I am happy today! How do you feel this morning?
• Call on 4-5 children to respond.
• Children: [Respond with words / sentences / actions: happy · sad · smile · cry]
• Say: Excellent! Today we will learn about "My Feelings". Ready?
• Children: "Yes!"

activities.title: Song and Warm-Up 5 min
activities.content:
• Say: We are going to sing a new song titled "If You're Happy and You Know It!" Listen first, 
then join in and do the actions.
• Say the words one line at a time. Children repeat after each line.
• Sing each line slowly and clearly, with actions.
• Sing all verses.
• Children perform the full 
song with actions.
• Say: What feelings did we 
just sing about?
• Children: [Name the emotion or need words from the 
song].

activities.title: Vocabulary Introduction 10 min
activities.content:
• Hold up HAPPY flashcard. Show a big happy face.
• Say: I am happy! Say: happy.
• Children: "Happy!"
• Hold up SAD. Show a sad face. 
• Say: I am sad. Say: sad. 
• Children: "Sad."
• Hold up SMILE. 
• Say: I SMILE when I am happy. Say: smile.
Song - If You're Happy and You Know It 
If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands! (clap clap) x 2
If you're happy and you know it, and you really want to show it,
If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands! (clap clap)
If you're sad and you know it, say "boo hoo"! (boo hoo) x 2
If you're sad and you know it, and you really want to show it,
If you're sad and you know it, say "boo hoo"! (boo hoo)

• Children: "Smile!"
• Hold up CRY . Mime crying. 
• Say: Sometimes we CRY when we are sad. Say: cry. 
• Children: "Cry."
• Say: Our sentence pattern is: I am ___. I am - HAPPY! Your turn!
• Children: "I am happy!" / "I am sad!"

activities.title: Feelings Game 7 min
activities.content:
• Say: We are going to play a "Feelings" game! I will make a face, and you will say the word 
and copy my expression!
• Make a big happy face. 
• Say: HAPPY! 
• Children: (big smile) "HAPPY!"
• Make a sad face. 
• Children: (sad face) "SAD!"
• Say: Now I am going to say the words, and you will do the actions.
• Say: SMILE! show me your biggest smile!
• Children: (Make smiles)
• Say: CRY!  make a crying face. It is okay, it is just pretend!
• Children: (Pretend crying)
• Say: Now,  I will make a face. You say the word AND the sentence.
• Teacher makes sad face. 
• Children: "Sad! I am sad!"
• Repeat for the other feelings.
• Call on 4-5 children to make a face for the class to guess.

• Say: Goodbye, everyone! See you next time!
• Children: Goodbye, teacher! See you next time!

activities.title: Story Read Aloud - First Reading 7 min
activities.content:
Before Reading
• Say: Story time! Our story this week is titled 'Amie's Day.' Listen for the feeling words.
• Show children the picture book.
• Say: Look at the picture, what do you see? (Allow children to respond in any language)
• Say: What do you think the story is about?" (Allow children to respond in any language)
• Call 2-3 learners to make predictions.
• Say: Let us read and find out. 
• Say: Amie is a girl in our story. Let us see how she feels today.
• Read the story aloud with full facial expression,  act out happy and sad.
After reading: 
• Say: Who smiles at her 
mother?
• Children: "Amie!"
• Say: Who takes Amie's 
pencil?
• Children: "Ebrima!"

• Say: Goodbye, everyone! See you next time!
• Children: Goodbye, teacher! See you next time!
Amie's Day
Amie wakes up on a sunny morning. She smiles at her mother. At 
school, Amie plays with her friend Ebrima. She is happy! Ebrima 
takes her pencil. Amie is sad.
"Give it back!" says Amie. Ebrima gives it back.
"I am sorry!" says Ebrima. He smiles. Amie smiles too.
Being kind makes everyone happy.

activities.title: Feelings Gallery 7 min
activities.content:
• Say: We are going to play our Feelings Portrait Gallery! Today we use our FACES as our 
portraits!"
• Say: Pick up your mirror. Look at your face. That is YOUR portrait!
• Say: Make a HAPPY face in your mirror. Look at yourself!
• Children: (make happy face, look in mirror)
• Say: Say the sentence!
• Children: "I am happy!"
• Say: Now make a SAD face. Look at yourself!
• Children: (make sad face, look in mirror)
• Say: Now make a SMILE. Look at yourself!
• Children: (smile) "I smile!" 
• Say: Now CRY . Look at yourself!
• Children: (cry face) "I cry!"
• Say: Say the sentence!
• Children: "I am sad!"
• Say: Now turn to your partner. Show your partner HAPPY . They copy and say the sentence.
• Child A: (makes happy face)
• Child B: "I am happy!" (copies the face)
• Say: Switch! Now show SAD.
• Child B: (makes sad face)
• Child A: "I am sad!" (copies the face)
• Say: Who would like to show the class both feelings? Come to the front!
• Call on 4-5 children. Each child makes both faces and says both sentences to the class.
• Child: "I am happy!" (happy face) "I am sad!" (sad face)
• Say: Everyone feels things every day! You are all feelings experts!

activities.title: Unit Family Celebration 7 min
activities.content:
• Say: UNIT CELEBRATION! You have completed the My Family unit. Stand up!
• Children: Stand up!
• Say: Now each of you will say ONE sentence about your family. I will start. Say: This is my 
class. You are my family at school!
• Go around. Each child says one sentence using any vocabulary from Weeks 6-9.
• Say: Give yourselves a clap! You are My Family Experts!
• Children: (cheer)

lessons.homework:
Celebrate with your family! Tell them everything you learned in the My Family 
unit.
• Say: Goodbye, everyone! See you next time!
• Children: Goodbye, teacher! See you next time!
